p: LRS1 Storyboard sheet for a premium jeweler HOMEPAGE, one single 16:9 image divided into a clean 3x3 grid of nine frames with thin black gutters, small white numbers 1 to 9 top left. Exactly the same look as the reference storyboard: deep black velvet darkness, narrow vertical slits of cool white light, deep cobalt navy velvet, platinum details, elegant German serif headlines, small LUPENREIN wordmark top left, a slim top navigation 'Diamanten Verlobungsringe Trauringe Schmuck & Uhren Ankauf Karriere' and a pill button 'Privater Termin' top right. A luxury jewelry SHOP that sells and advises, never a workshop. VERSION 1 'Ein Lichtschlitz führt durch alles'. Frame 1: the existing opening, a white gold emerald-cut engagement ring in a slit of light, headline 'Lupenrein.'. Frame 2: three engagement rings side by side in three light slits, labels 'Solitär' 'Halo' 'Smaragd', headline 'Welcher Ring passt zu Ihnen?'. Frame 3: macro of four double claws holding the stone in a light slit, small caption 'Unter der Lupe geprüft'. Frame 4: a vertical slit of light opens wider and reveals a pair of wedding bands on black velvet, headline 'Trauringe.', small metal swatches. Frame 5: a slowly turning ring of eight large jewelry photographs floating in the dark (rings, chains, a diamond collier, earrings, bracelets, a men's and a ladies' luxury wristwatch without brand), category pills 'Ringe Ketten Colliers Ohrschmuck Armbänder Uhren', headline 'Schmuck & Uhren.'. Frame 6: one photo from the ring has grown to fill the whole frame: a diamond collier large and sharp. Frame 7: old gold jewelry on a precision scale in a slit of light, beside it a calculator panel with a gram slider and buttons '333 585 750', big rolling digits, headline 'Altgold-Ankauf.'. Frame 8: a dark private lounge with navy velvet armchairs, a consultant offers a tray with three different rings, card 'Privater Termin'. Frame 9: smartphone vertical showing the same dark page. Photorealistic, razor sharp, no CGI look, no glow, no lens flares, NO white backgrounds anywhere, correct German spelling.
